headers.description: Optional. Specifies a collection of headers to match.

GrpcRouteRouteMatch.description: Criteria for matching traffic. A RouteMatch will be considered to match when all supplied fields match.

Empty.description: A generic empty message that you can re-use to avoid defining duplicated empty messages in your APIs. A typical example is to use it as the request or the response type of an API method. For instance: service Foo { rpc Bar(google.protobuf.Empty) returns (google.protobuf.Empty); }

trustConfig.description: Optional. The trust config resource name. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/trustConfigs/{trust_config}

enumDescriptions: Unspecified additional roots.
Trust only the certificates provided in `trust_config`.
Trust certificates provided in `trust_config` and publicly trusted roots.
additionalRoots.description: Optional. The additional roots to trust.

nextPageToken.description: If there might be more results than those appearing in this response, then `next_page_token` is included. To get the next set of results, call this method again using the value of `next_page_token` as `page_token`.

unreachable.description: Unreachable resources. Populated when the request attempts to list all resources across all supported locations, while some locations are temporarily unavailable.

GrpcRouteHeaderMatch.description: A match against a collection of headers.

key.description: Required. The key of the header.

enumDescriptions: Unspecified.
Will only match the exact value provided.
Will match paths conforming to the prefix specified by value. RE2 syntax is supported.
type.description: Optional. Specifies how to match against the value of the header. If not specified, a default value of EXACT is used.

value.description: Required. The value of the header.
